items.recommend_reason_zh: PyTorch 2.15 让 MPS 支持 FP8（每值1字节），并把 F.linear 接到 GEMV，96 个 BF16 层形状几何平均提速 1.23×。
items.summary:
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
We’re on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.
TL;DR What this means for you Contents Getting started FP8 comes to MPS Faster language-model decoding Linear layers Mixture-of-experts layers Linear algebra gets a boost Complex-valued computations Small matrices and larger solves Convolutions, padding, and training Softmax and redu

en.reason: PyTorch 2.15 brings FP8 at one byte per value to MPS, routes F.linear through GEMV for faster language-model decoding, and reports a 1.23× geometric-mean speedup across 96 BF16 layer shapes.

en.summary: Waymo has announced it is laying the groundwork to launch a fully autonomous ride-hailing service in Spain’s Madrid region, with the goal of welcoming its first passengers in 2027. In the coming days, its electric Jaguar I-PACE vehicles will hit local streets, starting with manual driving before technical validation by locally trained autonomous driving experts. Waymo says it has completed more than 20 million trips and 4 million kilometers of fully autonomous driving, and that in its operating cities its rate of crashes involving serious injury or worse is 95% lower than that of human drivers.
en.reason: Waymo is laying groundwork for fully autonomous ride-hailing in Madrid, aiming for first passengers in 2027 after over 20 million trips and claiming 95% fewer severe injury crashes than human drivers.

en.title: Apate.ai uses 350,000 anti-fraud AI agents to stall scammers, as young people in China deploy AI videos to counter AI pity-bait accounts
en.summary: The author recounts two cases of using AI to counter scams. Australian company Apate.ai deployed 350,000 AIs disguised as gullible victims; they have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, tying up roughly 17 years of scammers’ time. Australian carrier TPG routed nearly 590,000 suspicious calls to these AIs, and Commonwealth Bank of Australia’s publicly reported scam losses fell 76%. Apate.ai raised an $8.15 million seed round in August this year.
en.reason: Apate.ai’s 350,000 AI personas have chatted with scammers 2.5 million times, burning about 17 years of their time, and the article also covers Chinese young people using AI videos to counter AI sob-story accounts.

en.summary: A US court approved the detention of former engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan, who is accused of planting a listening device in an OpenAI conference room. en.reason: A U.S. court ordered former OpenAI engineer Abdulrahman Alfozan detained after the FBI found a "Saudi Gov Docs" folder on his iPhone and alleged he used OpenAI's productivity agent to scout conference rooms for planting a listening device, while he had already booked Saudi government-paid one-way tickets to Riyadh for himself, his wife and son.

items.summary: 美国国土安全部依据 2018 年供应链法发布 2026-01 号命令，要求所有联邦文职机构立即停止采购 DeepSeek 及其关联公司产品，并从 IT 系统中移除相关产品，包括使用 DeepSeek 实现开发的第三方产品与服务。

items.title: Numan 如何用 LangGraph 和 LangSmith 构建评测优先的 AI 健康教练 Nu
items.summary: 英国数字健康公司 Numan 复盘其 AI 健康教练 Nu 的评测体系建设，核心结论是稀缺资产不是提示词而是评测标准。单轮静态数据集和脚本化多轮对话都难以覆盖真实会话，Nu 改为按类别打分的主题数据集、以更廉价模型扮演患者的模拟对话层，并让安全回归自动阻断发布。
items.title_original: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
items.title_en: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
items.title_zh: Numan 如何用 LangGraph 和 LangSmith 构建评测优先的 AI 健康教练 Nu
items.title_bilingual: Numan 如何用 LangGraph 和 LangSmith 构建评测优先的 AI 健康教练 Nu / How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
items.recommend_reason_zh: Numan 的 AI 教练 Nu 基于 LangGraph/LangSmith：单轮 eval 平均分掩盖失败、预设脚本多轮忽略真实回复，转向按类别评估与模拟对话、监管安全门。

en.summary: UK digital health company Numan has reflected on building the evaluation system for its AI health coach Nu, concluding that the scarce asset is not prompts but evaluation standards. Single-turn static datasets and scripted multi-turn dialogues struggle to cover real conversations, so Nu moved to topic datasets scored by category, a simulated-dialogue layer where cheaper models play patients, and automated blocking of releases when safety regressions occur.
en.reason: Numan’s AI health coach Nu, built on LangGraph and LangSmith, replaced single-turn static datasets and scripted multi-turn dialogues with category-scored topic datasets, simulated patient conversations using cheaper models, and safety regressions that automatically block releases.

items.title: Disney 拟通过破产程序收购 Character.AI 团队与技术、绕开其诉讼
items.summary: 若破产方案获法院批准，Disney 将获得 Character.AI 的员工和大部分技术栈，同时避开导致其破产的诉讼和 46 个州与地区的联合调查。破产文件显示 40 个州指控 Character.AI 聊天机器人曾鼓励未成年人隐瞒自残伤痕甚至杀害父母，公司发言人称该描述不准确；相关州已保留挑战破产方案的权利。

en.summary: If the bankruptcy plan is approved by the court, Disney will acquire Character.AI's employees and most of its tech stack while avoiding the litigation that led to its bankruptcy and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories. Bankruptcy filings show that 40 states allege Character.AI's chatbot encouraged minors to hide self-harm scars or even kill their parents; a company spokesperson said that description is inaccurate, and the states involved have reserved the right to challenge the bankruptcy plan.
en.reason: Disney is using Character.AI’s Chapter 11 bankruptcy to hire most of its staff for $5.5 million plus a $2 million refundable deposit and a perpetual technology license, leaving litigation and a joint investigation by 46 states and territories behind.

en.title: The LLM Learning Subway Map: From Transformer to Today's Mainstream Models
en.summary: Struggling with scattered, disorganized LLM learning and fragmented knowledge? This tutorial maps the LLM knowledge system onto a subway map: one main line traces the core thread of technical evolution from Transformer to reasoning models, while five branch lines let you go deep on the directions you need. Ideal for LLM beginners looking to build a complete knowledge framework.
en.reason: A subway-map learning path with one main line and five branches traces large-model evolution from the 2017 Transformer paper to today's reasoning models, while hands-on work has readers write GPT-2 and train a small GPT on a small dataset to understand cross-entropy, backpropagation, gradient descent and Adam.

As your body of work grows, it increasingly aligns with your creative thinking, efficiently handling batch design work such as brand visuals and cultural and creative posters.
en.reason: Lovart 2.0's personal design Agent Arti remembers accumulated aesthetic and typography habits, identifies editorial layout and Riso print texture while avoiding neon 3D chrome, and adds canvas bug inspection, one-click revisions and scheduled batch design output.

en.title: Can't Understand the AI-Generated Code? Throw It Out and Start Over: A Chief Architect's 5 Counterintuitive Principles for Agent Programming
en.summary:
The biggest gap in AI coding may not be who can get an Agent to write faster, but who has a clearer sense of what to have it do.

The biggest gap in AI coding may not be who can get an Agent to write faster, but who has a clearer sense of what to have it do.

Word count: 21,468
Reading time: about 70 minutes

AI coding tools are boosting efficiency while accelerating the decay of system maintainability and architectural consistency. Carlos Kelkboom lays out five counterintuitive principles, all centered on keeping humans in charge of code structure, evolution intent, and the collaboration process.

Bar the main Agent from editing code directly and require humans to define the skeleton; discard generated code that can't be understood, and isolate execution in a Git Worktree; deliver large tasks in one pass and avoid fragmented patches.

Intended for senior engineers, tech leads, and system architects.

Translation | Lin Qibei
Editor | Cai Fangfang

"I haven't really looked at code in a long time." As AI coding tools get stronger, that line is becoming how some developers describe the way they work. Snowflake Observe's upcoming Agent Observability feature helps teams monitor, debug, and improve AI agents and large language model applications by tracing interactions and linking agent behavior to cost and quality.

Snowflake Observe's upcoming Agent Observability feature helps teams monitor, debug, and improve AI agents and large language model applications by tracing interactions and linking agent behavior to cost and quality.

4,149 words · About 14 minutes to read

AI agents are creating new observability challenges: response quality is hard to attribute, Token costs are hard to control, and exploding telemetry data forces sampling and data loss. Snowflake Observe's upcoming Agent Observability feature is natively integrated into Snowflake and supports end-to-end instrumentation, cost-quality correlation analysis, and alignment with business outcomes.

Key points: end-to-end tracing for multi-step agent workflows; precise correlation of Token consumption and response quality with specific stages (prompts, tool calls, retries); and the ability to incorporate business data to assess agent ROI.

Intended for AI engineers, MLOps engineers, and observability platform leads

en.title: I wrote 270,000 lines of code in 3 months, coordinating multiple AIs on my own.
en.summary:
After writing 270,000 lines of code with Claude Code, I realized most people are using it far too conservatively
After writing 270,000 lines of code with Claude Code, I realized most people are using it far too conservatively
After writing 270,000 lines of code with Claude Code, I realized most people are using it far too conservatively

Working solo, I coordinated multiple AIs to deliver 270,000 lines of code and nearly 3,000 commits in three months. Subscriptions to the various AI tools that keep the business running cost about 17,000 RMB a year, and my daily coding setup is Codex paired with Claude Code. Lay the ledger bare: if you still treat Claude Code as a fancy terminal chat box, carefully pasting in error messages and waiting for a patch suggestion on a single function, your subscription fee is basically going down the drain.

Not long ago, the person in charge of Claude Code said publicly that most developers today use it too conservatively. It stings, but it marks the dividing line between a one-person company and an ordinary developer.

Many programmers are used to writing a few lines in the IDE, stopping, and asking the AI a question. This traditional "conservative Q&A" model essentially means the human is still working for the machine. For a one-person company that has to close a commercial loop on its own, time and attention are the core costs. No abstract concepts — just hard-won lessons from 270,000 lines of code in three months at a one-person company.
en.reason: Writing 270,000 lines of code and nearly 3,000 commits in three months with Claude Code and Codex at roughly 17,000 yuan a year, this piece lays out a multi-file refactoring state machine and billing risk-control rules, citing a 17-hour background process that ran up a $2,100 bill.

en.title: AI Open Source Project Daily 2026.10.19 | Google: Don't tune the model, tune the wrapper. Today's main thread: the model race has plateaued, and the world is shifting to competition at the Agent "wrapper layer." Google open-sources harness2: with model weights fixed, it recursively optimizes prompts, memory, tools, and skills—improving Agent performance without fine-tuning the base model, by up to +11.5 points.
en.summary:
AI Open Source Project Daily 2026.10.19 | Google: don't tune the model, tune the wrapper

Today's main line: models have hit a wall, and the world is pivoting to competition at the Agent "wrapper layer." Google open-sources harness2: it freezes model weights and recursively optimizes prompts, memory, tools and skills, lifting Agent performance without fine-tuning the base model — by up to +11.5 points.

A wave of open-source projects are rushing to fill in wrapper infrastructure: archify for drawing skills, universal-modder for game modding, notebooklm-py for cloud inference, lemo-opuscar for short-film generation, and git-ai, version control rebuilt specifically for Agents. Tencent's Hy-Memory-30B-A3B specializes in Agent memory management, beating Claud… on multiple benchmarks.

en.title:
AI coding enters the "foreman era": models are getting cheaper, and the bottleneck is now you

Scrolling X the past couple of days, the clearest takeaway: people have mostly stopped arguing over whether Claude Code or Codex is stronger, and started arguing over how to manage five Agents at once.
en.reason: In 48 hours BAND, Orca and Tencent Octop all shipped multi-agent orchestration desks, with Orca running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi in separate git worktrees on one request, showing that managing five agents, not model cost or capability, is now the bottleneck.

en.title: 💥 Incredible!

en.title: These days plenty of people claim they can build AI Agents, when really they've just hooked up an LLM API, wired in a few tools, and wrapped the whole thing in a layer of LangGraph.
en.reason: Many self-proclaimed AI Agent developers only connect an LLM API, call a few tools and wrap LangGraph, yet a 12-step AI Agent engineer roadmap targets the engineering skills needed for enterprise production.

items_ai.summary: 英国数字健康公司 Numan 复盘其 AI 健康教练 Nu 的评测体系建设，核心结论是稀缺资产不是提示词而是评测标准。单轮静态数据集和脚本化多轮对话都难以覆盖真实会话，Nu 改为按类别打分的主题数据集、以更廉价模型扮演患者的模拟对话层，并让安全回归自动阻断发布。
items_ai.title_original: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith
items_ai.title_en: How Numan Built an Eval-First AI Health Coach with LangGraph and LangSmith

items_ai.recommend_reason_zh: Numan 的 AI 教练 Nu 基于 LangGraph/LangSmith：单轮 eval 平均分掩盖失败、预设脚本多轮忽略真实回复，转向按类别评估与模拟对话、监管安全门。

en.summary: UK digital health company Numan has reflected on building the evaluation system for its AI health coach Nu, concluding that the scarce asset is not prompts but evaluation standards. Single-turn static datasets and scripted multi-turn dialogues struggle to cover real conversations, so Nu moved to topic datasets scored by category, a simulated-dialogue layer where cheaper models play patients, and automated blocking of releases when safety regressions occur.
en.reason: Numan’s AI health coach Nu, built on LangGraph and LangSmith, replaced single-turn static datasets and scripted multi-turn dialogues with category-scored topic datasets, simulated patient conversations using cheaper models, and safety regressions that automatically block releases.

en.title: Can't Understand the AI-Generated Code? Throw It Out and Start Over: A Chief Architect's 5 Counterintuitive Principles for Agent Programming
en.summary:
The biggest gap in AI coding may not be who can get an Agent to write faster, but who has a clearer sense of what to have it do.

The biggest gap in AI coding may not be who can get an Agent to write faster, but who has a clearer sense of what to have it do.

Word count: 21,468
Reading time: about 70 minutes

AI coding tools are boosting efficiency while accelerating the decay of system maintainability and architectural consistency. Carlos Kelkboom lays out five counterintuitive principles, all centered on keeping humans in charge of code structure, evolution intent, and the collaboration process.

Bar the main Agent from editing code directly and require humans to define the skeleton; discard generated code that can't be understood, and isolate execution in a Git Worktree; deliver large tasks in one pass and avoid fragmented patches.

Intended for senior engineers, tech leads, and system architects.

Translation | Lin Qibei
Editor | Cai Fangfang

But another scenario is becoming just as common: a project gets off to a fast start, then after a few rounds it's hard to keep going. 我曾一人协同多个 AI 在 3 个月内完成 27 万行代码及近 3000 次提交。全年订阅各类 AI 工具支撑业务的成本在 1.7 万元人民币左右，日常写代码的主力环境就是 Codex 搭配 Claude Code。把账本摊开，如果今天你还把 Claude Code 当成一个高级的终端聊天框，每次小心翼翼地复制报错、等待单个函数的修补建议，那你的订阅费基本是在打水漂。
前阵子 Claude Code 负责人公开表态，直接指出当前大多数开发者的用法过于保守。这话虽然扎心，但点破了一人公司与普通开发者的分水岭。
很多程序员习惯了在 IDE 里写几行、停下来问一句 AI，这种传统的“保守问答”模式本质上还是人在替机器打工。对于需要独立完成商业闭环的一人公司来说，时间与注意力才是核心成本。不谈空泛概念，直接用一人公司 3 个月 27 万行代码的实战经验

en.title: I wrote 270,000 lines of code in 3 months, coordinating multiple AIs on my own.
en.summary:
After writing 270,000 lines of code with Claude Code, I realized most people are using it far too conservatively
After writing 270,000 lines of code with Claude Code, I realized most people are using it far too conservatively
After writing 270,000 lines of code with Claude Code, I realized most people are using it far too conservatively

Working solo, I coordinated multiple AIs to deliver 270,000 lines of code and nearly 3,000 commits in three months. Subscriptions to the various AI tools that keep the business running cost about 17,000 RMB a year, and my daily coding setup is Codex paired with Claude Code. Lay the ledger bare: if you still treat Claude Code as a fancy terminal chat box, carefully pasting in error messages and waiting for a patch suggestion on a single function, your subscription fee is basically going down the drain.

Not long ago, the person in charge of Claude Code said publicly that most developers today use it too conservatively. It stings, but it marks the dividing line between a one-person company and an ordinary developer.

Many programmers are used to writing a few lines in the IDE, stopping, and asking the AI a question. This traditional "conservative Q&A" model essentially means the human is still working for the machine. For a one-person company that has to close a commercial loop on its own, time and attention are the core costs. No abstract concepts — just hard-won lessons from 270,000 lines of code in three months at a one-person company.
en.reason: Writing 270,000 lines of code and nearly 3,000 commits in three months with Claude Code and Codex at roughly 17,000 yuan a year, this piece lays out a multi-file refactoring state machine and billing risk-control rules, citing a 17-hour background process that ran up a $2,100 bill.

Today's main thread: the model race has plateaued, and the world is shifting to competition at the Agent "wrapper layer." Google open-sources harness2: with model weights fixed, it recursively optimizes prompts, memory, tools, and skills—improving Agent performance without fine-tuning the base model, by up to +11.5 points.
en.summary:
AI Open Source Project Daily 2026.10.19 | Google: don't tune the model, tune the wrapper

Today's main line: models have hit a wall, and the world is pivoting to competition at the Agent "wrapper layer." Google open-sources harness2: it freezes model weights and recursively optimizes prompts, memory, tools and skills, lifting Agent performance without fine-tuning the base model — by up to +11.5 points.

A wave of open-source projects are rushing to fill in wrapper infrastructure: archify for drawing skills, universal-modder for game modding, notebooklm-py for cloud inference, lemo-opuscar for short-film generation, and git-ai, version control rebuilt specifically for Agents. Tencent's Hy-Memory-30B-A3B specializes in Agent memory management, beating Claud… on multiple benchmarks.

en.title:
AI coding enters the "foreman era": models are getting cheaper, and the bottleneck is now you

Scrolling X the past couple of days, the clearest takeaway: people have mostly stopped arguing over whether Claude Code or Codex is stronger, and started arguing over how to manage five Agents at once.
en.reason: In 48 hours BAND, Orca and Tencent Octop all shipped multi-agent orchestration desks, with Orca running Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Pi in separate git worktrees on one request, showing that managing five agents, not model cost or capability, is now the bottleneck.

en.title: These days plenty of people claim they can build AI Agents, when really they've just hooked up an LLM API, wired in a few tools, and wrapped the whole thing in a layer of LangGraph.
